paragraphs: Mentioned in Yevamot 8a: Rav Acha bar Bibi Mar said to Ravina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Yevamot8a follows the period convention; no named witness was supplied to verify the edition or locator.
א״ל means said to. Rav Acha bar Bibi Mar addresses Ravina, not the reverse. Full Rav and the supplied Bibi Mar form remain, without reassigning Mar or asserting further identity.
